description: This file contains unit tests for the FeaturePropertiesDeleted class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling related to FeaturePropertiesDeleted.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesDeletedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the FeaturePropertiesDeleted event, verifying behavior such as immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeaturePropertiesDeleted instances are immutable and that FeatureProperties used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for FeaturePropertiesDeleted using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Confirms that creating a FeaturePropertiesDeleted instance with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Confirms that creating a FeaturePropertiesDeleted instance with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Confirms that creating a FeaturePropertiesDeleted instance with a null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation of the event.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON to a FeaturePropertiesDeleted instance and verifies its properties.
